S1:12.text: Moreouer Arphaxad liued thirtie fiue yeares, and begat Sale.

S1:13.text: And Arphaxad liued after he begat Sale, three hundred three yeares and begat ſonnes and daughters.

S1:15.text: And Sale liued. after he begat Heber, foure hundred three yeares: and begat ſonnes and daughters.

S1:25.text: And Nachor liued after he begot Thare, an hundred and nintene yeares and begat ſonnes and daughters.

S3:1.text: And the earth was of one tongue, and alone ſpeach.

S3:12.text: Moreouer Arphaxad liued thirtie fiue yeares, and begat Sale.

S3:13.text: And Arphaxad liued after he begat Sale, three hundred three yeares and begat ſonnes and daughters.

S3:15.text: And Sale liued after he begat Heber, foure hundred three yeares: and begat ſonnes and daughters.

S3:22.text: And Sarug liued thirtie yeares, and begat Nachor.

S3:25.text: And Nachor liued after he begot Thare, an hundred and nintene yeares and begat ſonnes and daughters.

S3:29.text: And Abram & Nachor maried wiues: the name of Abram his wife was Sarai: and the name of Nachor his Wife, Melcha the daughter of Aran the father of Melcha, and the father of Ieſcha.

S3:9.text: And therfore the name thereof was called Babel, becauſe there the tongue of the whole earth was confounded and from thence our Lord diſperſed them vpon the face of al countries.

S6:11.text: And Sem liued after he begat Arphaxad, fiue hundred yea- res, and begat ſonnes and daughters.

S6:13.text: And Arphaxad liued after he begat Sale three hundred three yeares, and begat ſonnes and daughters.

S6:14.text: Sale alſo liued thirie yeares, and begat Heber.

S6:15.text: And Sale liued after he begat Heber, foure hundred three ycares, & begat ſonnes & daughters.

S6:16.text: And Heber liued thirtie foure ycares, and begat Phaleg.

S6:17.text: And Heber liued after he begat Phaleg, foure hundred thirtie yearcs, and begat ſonues and daughters.

S6:18.text: Phaleg alſo liued thirte ycares, and begat Reu.

S6:25.text: And Nachor liuer after he begat Thare an hundred and nineteen yeares, and begat ſonnes and daughters.

S6:3.text: And each one ſaid to his neighbour: Come, let vs make brick, and bake them with fire. And they had brick inſtead of ſtone and bitume inſtead of morter

S6:4.text: and they ſaid, Come, let vs make vs a citie and a towre, the top wherof may reach to heauen: and let vs renowne our name before we be diſperſed into al lands.

S6:6.text: and he ſaid: Behold, it is one people, and one tong is to al: and they haue begun to doe this, neyther wil they leaue off from their determinations, til they accompliſh them indeed.

S6:8.text: And ſo our Lord diſperſed them from that place into al lands and they ceaſed to build the citie.
